items.information:
## 대회 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대회 참가가 불가능합니다.
## 참가 확정 / 대기 명단은 3일 내로 갱신되니, 참가 신청 이후 명단에서 본인의 이름을 확인해 주시기를 바랍니다.
## 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다.

참가비 납부는 [대회 신청 및 참가비 납부](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreanChampionship2024#42776-registration-and-payment-details) 탭을 눌러 확인해주세요. 

모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

___
## Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist.
## Within 3 days of paying the registration fee, you should be able to see your name on either the competitor list or waitlist.
## Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers.

Please see [Registration and Payment Details](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreanChampionship2024#42776-registration-and-payment-details) tab for registration fee information.

All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers.

items.name: BrizZon Side Open III 2024
items.information:
Trzecie zawody z cyklu zawodów Brizzon w 2024 roku, tym razem spotykamy się na wyjątkowo długo, bo aż na 4 dni.
Zapraszamy zarówno stałych bywalców jak i nowych zawodników na bardzo długi weekend majowy skupiony na konkurencjach side’owych.

---

The third competition in the Brizzon series in 2024, this time we meet for an exceptionally long time, up to 4 days.
We invite both regulars and new competitors for a very long weekend focused on side competitions.
